Coram : K.G. BALAKRISHNAN*, R.V. RAVEENDRAN, J.M. PANCHAL
Service law - Recruitment by UPSC - For the posts in c Municipal Corporation of Delhi (MCD) - Advertisement prescribing age relaxation to the employees of MCD- Contract employees on the same post seeking age relaxation for regular appointment - Held: to age relaxation - In absence of restrictive meaning of 'employee' D either under Delhi Municipal Corporation Act or under UPSC advertisement, 'employee' would include both permanent and temporary - Thus relaxation is applicable to both - Delhi Municipal Corporation Act, 1957.
